topic: Where the FICO credit score came from

sources.claim: Fair Isaac Corporation launched the first standardized consumer FICO score in February 1989, subsequently adopted by the major credit bureaus
sources.source: myFICO 'History of the FICO Score'; corroborated by multiple credit-history retrospectives

sources.claim: Fair Isaac Corporation itself was founded earlier, in 1956, by Bill Fair and Earl Isaac (not stated in final script, background only)
